schedule: Relative phases only; no calendar dates or deadlines. Work at available capacity. Weeks are sequencing units, not commitments.

phases.gate: Sandbox and local LLM feasibility recorded; schema-valid synthetic end-to-end exchange; blockers recorded.
Report, parse, classify, explain and reply in the lab; measure the one-minute goal on named hardware/model; freeze the test set; Microsoft 365 go/no-go.
Containment tests pass before any unknown live URL; screenshot/form evidence and validated verdict; protect Week 12 for integration.
Defensible synthetic clusters; copies found only in authorised mailboxes; corroborated brand signals; mid-project demo.
One provider supports propose, approve, quarantine, audit and restore; zero incorrect removals on the test set.
Mandatory security/contract tests pass; reproducible comparisons; plugin API frozen; protect Week 24 for integration.
Outside tester installs, runs the synthetic demo and reports a reproducible issue; fresh final test set; no unsupported claims.
Fresh reviewer completes install, analyse, evidence, search, approve, quarantine and restore; security sign-off and reproducible final results.

tasks.title: [M1][C01] Bootstrap FastAPI, logging, CI and Compose
acceptance: Editable install and offline fixture demo work from clean checkout
Lint, types and tests run on every PR
Compose is loopback-only and has no credentials, mail access or action execution
tasks.deliverable: Bootstrap FastAPI, logging, CI and Compose

tasks.title: [M1][C02] Implement a bounded defensive MIME parser
acceptance: Parse 20 synthetic .eml samples into Evidence v1 with headers, bodies, URLs, QR and attachment metadata
Enforce size, recursion and time budgets with explicit failure states
Malformed nested MIME and oversized inputs have regression tests
tasks.deliverable: Implement a bounded defensive MIME parser

tasks.title: [M1][C03] Add deterministic sender and URL checks
acceptance: Reply-To mismatch, lookalikes, URL structure and domain-age checks return evidence, severity and confidence
Authentication provenance distinguishes trusted ingress results from spoofed headers
Failed lookups remain unknown and never prove safety
tasks.deliverable: Add deterministic sender and URL checks

tasks.title: [M1][C04] Run mailbox-access and sandbox feasibility spikes
acceptance: Record IMAP/Gmail test-account access and request a Microsoft 365 test tenant
Screenshot an owned synthetic page using a disposable isolated VM with private networks and credentials blocked
Record sandbox go/no-go and disable uncontrolled navigation; no live remediation
tasks.deliverable: Run mailbox-access and sandbox feasibility spikes

tasks.title: [M1][A01] Design labelled data and scripted synthetic corpus
acceptance: Specify at least several hundred labelled messages with provenance and licences
Include credential, payment, urgency, impersonation, legitimate and legitimate-but-urgent categories

tasks.deliverable: Design labelled data and scripted synthetic corpus

tasks.title: [M1][A02] Train reproducible TF-IDF logistic baseline
